findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 130 requests to 21 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 12.1 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 6.7 MB (55%) came from third-party domains, 262 kB of it from services classified as tracking (13 requests).

5 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), doubleverify.com (DoubleVerify, advertising), fwmrm.net (FreeWheel, advertising), parsely.com (Parse.ly, analytics).
7 cookies were set by third-party domains (42 cookies in total).

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47296 rules), 36 requests were blocked. The page still made 130 requests to 21 third-party domains, including 5 tracking services in our list.
